## Projects

- [Cash Clinic — Interactive Video Platform](https://www.khaledrefaat.dev/#projects): Financial-education platform built around a fully custom interactive video learning experience — custom video player with sectioned navigation, embedded questions and notes, saved progress, downloadable resources, drag-and-drop layout editing, and multi-language support. Built with Next.js, TypeScript, Zustand, dnd-kit, Framer Motion, next-intl, Zod, React Hook Form, and Tailwind CSS.
- [Cr8 — Designer Marketplace Platform](https://www.khaledrefaat.dev/#projects): Marketplace where designers upload, customize, and sell their products — similar to Redbubble. Features a custom mockup editor using 2D canvas and PSD smart-object replacement for realistic product previews, designer store management, a customer-facing shop, and an analytics dashboard. Built with Next.js, TypeScript, Zustand, TanStack Query, ag-psd, next-intl, Zod, React Hook Form, and Tailwind CSS.
